name: MonarchRangeSlider
title: RangeSlider
summary: A slider for a range of two numbers, in the look of MonarchSlider; the thumbs do not cross.
whenToUse: For a range where the positions matter more than exact numbers: a price filter, working hours, an age band.
whenNotToUse: For one value use the Material 3 Slider. For exact numbers use two MonarchNumberInput fields. For dates use the Material 3 DateRangePicker.
api: @Composable fun MonarchRangeSlider(value: ClosedFloatingPointRange<Float>, onValueChange: (ClosedFloatingPointRange<Float>) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, enabled: Boolean = true, valueRange: ClosedFloatingPointRange<Float> = 0f..1f, steps: Int = 0, onValueChangeFinished: (() -> Unit)? = null, invalid: Boolean = false, label: String? = null, valueLabel: ((Float) -> String)? = null)

options.name: valueLabel
options.description: Formats one end; the label row shows start and end.

options.name: enabled
options.description: A disabled control is drawn at half opacity and ignores input.

states.name: range
states.description: The track between the thumbs and the thumbs use the accent strong color; the rest of the track the accent subtle color.

states.name: thumbs together
states.description: Both thumbs at one value; each can only move away from the other.

states.name: pressed
states.description: Material narrows the thumb that is dragged.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Material 3 disabled colors; the values do not change by touch.

appearance: MonarchTheme maps the Material 3 scheme so that the thumbs and the active track use the accent strong color and the inactive track the accent subtle color. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: Built on the Material 3 RangeSlider; TalkBack names the thumbs "Range start" and "Range end". 48dp touch target. Migrating: RangeSlider(value, onValueChange, ...) becomes MonarchRangeSlider(value, onValueChange, ...); drop colors.
accessibility: Each thumb is its own TalkBack element with a range and a value; TalkBack's adjust gestures move one thumb, and it stops at the other thumb.
The thumbs are named "Range start" and "Range end" by Material 3.

The slider is 48dp high and the whole track takes the drag, picking the nearer thumb, so the touch target of both thumbs is the track; each thumb's own TalkBack bounds are narrower (about 20 by 44dp).
The lower thumb is at the start edge in both layout directions.
A disabled range slider is read as disabled.
edgeCases: steps counts the points between the ends, not the intervals.
A value outside valueRange is drawn at the nearest end.
In right-to-left layouts the track fills from the right and the lower value is on the right.
The thumbs' spoken value is the raw number (for example 0.2), not the formatted text; say the range in a visible Text.

examples.title: Price filter
examples.template:
MonarchFormField(label = {{label}}, helperText = {{description}}) { controlModifier ->
    MonarchRangeSlider(
        value = price,
        onValueChange = { price = it },
        modifier = controlModifier,
        valueRange = {{min}}f..{{max}}f,
        steps = ({{max}} - {{min}}) / {{step}} - 1,
        valueLabel = { {{valuePrefix}} + it.toInt() },
    )
}
examples.code:
MonarchFormField(label = "Price", helperText = "Results update when you let go.") { controlModifier ->
    MonarchRangeSlider(
        value = price,
        onValueChange = { price = it },
        modifier = controlModifier,
        valueRange = 0f..1000f,
        steps = (1000 - 0) / 50 - 1,
        valueLabel = { "\$" + it.toInt() },
    )
}
